verdict.rationale: The only related control in the evidence is Privacy Mode, which ensures code is "never used for training by Cursor or other AI model providers" and is on by default for Enterprise teams. That limits how data is used, but it is not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. Other items, such as OpenTelemetry Export and the Analytics API, show usage data being collected and streamed rather than disabled. missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, a description of what telemetry is collected and what the opt-out stops, per-user (non-Enterprise) controls, and independent corroboration.
